offset_origin: zero-based absolute byte offset from module header

cases.name: reference_bottom_throw_ref
cases.semantic: Ref(Bot,false) from dead ref.as_non_null is a subtype of nullable exn.

cases.name: reference_bottom_numeric_rejection
cases.semantic: Reference-only bottom cannot match i32 even when the current control frame is unreachable.

cases.name: memory32_core3_padded_u64_zero
cases.semantic: Core 3 memarg.offset is u64 even for memory32; nonminimal six-byte zero is valid.

cases.name: memory32_offset_2pow32
cases.semantic: u64 encoding succeeds, but offset 2^32 is outside the selected i32 memory address width.

cases.name: truncated_gc_subopcode
cases.semantic: The FB subopcode LEB reaches the bounded body end without a terminating byte.

cases.name: try_table_catch_kind_not_leb
cases.semantic: Catch kind is one literal byte in 0..3; 0x80 must not be decoded as a padded LEB.

cases.name: br_on_cast_reserved_flags
cases.semantic: Cast branch flags are one literal byte in 0..3; bit 2 is reserved.

cases.name: padded_abstract_exn_heap
cases.semantic: Abstract exn heap is a single-byte production 0x69, not a padded negative s33.

cases.name: zero_count_local_unknown_heap
cases.semantic: A zero-count local run still validates its declared (ref null typeidx); typeidx 1 is absent.
